To start off, we're going to set up tracking for the input data.

We'll do this in the same manner that we did for 
the MAHERYCohortHarmonization package, so we'll
just import that package here and use the same functions.

```{r}
# install the development version of the package from GitHub
# remotes::install_github("Climate-Smart-Public-Health/MAHERYCohortHarmonization")
library(MAHERYCohortHarmonization)
```

Other libraries we'll need:

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(googledrive)
library(stringr)
```

Note that the interactions with Google Drive will require you to authenticate your Google account.
Just like in the MAHERYCohortHarmonization package, I'm using a service account to access the Google Drive files,
authenticated by a JSON key file.
